aatttttaaa: Nobody saw Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-C16, and a quiet rifleman under it.

Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus was grazed. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

An empty jam tin became Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 699. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa reads Bastian Historygeek's letters from home out loud, because Bastian never learned to read. Saint leaves out the sad parts. Bastian knows.
Bastian Historygeek and Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa was carrying water up to R-C16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa did not. Shot by Teodor Dritte of the Hegemony (@jones.der.dritte).
Someone moved Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
For days Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
aiden.m_55: Pavel "Crow" Aiden found a place in R-C16 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Pavel "Crow" Aiden shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Pavel "Crow" Aiden gave Florian "Spark" Cwilliam the last match in the trench. Spark used it to light a candle so that Crow could finish a letter. Pavel "Crow" Aiden got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 923. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-C16 changed before the cheering ended. Pavel "Crow" Aiden shouldered another load.
A man asked Pavel "Crow" Aiden to describe Old Harrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Pavel "Crow" Aiden kept Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Crow could have walked there blind.
Pavel "Crow" Aiden discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
Pavel "Crow" Aiden was hit in the foot through his boot at R-C16. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Leopold Domgas of the Concord (@domgas_1).
Pavel "Crow" Aiden waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Pavel "Crow" Aiden no longer needed it.
A letter came with Edmund Aiden: "I am Pavel "Crow" Aiden's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Someone asked Edmund Aiden to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
aoidragon1: Marek "Saint" Aoidragon told the sergeant he was a postman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Marek "Saint" Aoidragon's ear at N-F6 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Viktor Fluffybaldy of the Concord (@fluffybaldy).
Marek "Saint" Aoidragon's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at N-F6 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

Marek "Saint" Aoidragon was hit in the hip at N-F6. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Bram "Mole" Act of the Concord (@a_realclass_act2). Marek "Saint" Aoidragon died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The papers say Otto Aoidragon. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Marek "Saint" Aoidragon's eyes. Nobody in N-F6 argues.
cashbandicoot3: The old hands of R-R14 have been here since Day 1. Matthias Cashbandicoo has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-R14 changed before the cheering ended. Matthias Cashbandicoo shouldered another load. Orders came through: Matthias Cashbandicoo is a stretcher bearer now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.

Someone asked Matthias Cashbandicoo to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Cashbandicoo. Matthias Cashbandicoo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Matthias Cashbandicoo helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Matthias Cashbandicoo got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Cashbandicoo. Matthias Cashbandicoo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fog so thick that Matthias Cashbandicoo could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Cashbandicoo. Matthias Cashbandicoo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went into Matthias Cashbandicoo's chest just under the heart at R-R14. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Matthias Cashbandicoo. He was asleep before they set him down. Matthias Cashbandicoo ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Cashbandicoo. Matthias Cashbandicoo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A medic brought Matthias Cashbandicoo half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Cashbandicoo. Matthias Cashbandicoo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medics called Matthias Cashbandicoo 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Matthias Cashbandicoo is back on the line. A letter from home reached Matthias Cashbandicoo before dusk. Matthias Cashbandicoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Cashbandicoo wrote back to Clara and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. Matthias Cashbandicoo's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
cookfamilypictures: Nobody saw Valentin Cookfamilypi arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in U-F3, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it.

A patient at the aid post asked Valentin Cookfamilypi for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Valentin Cookfamilypi watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Valentin Cookfamilypi lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Valentin Cookfamilypi as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Valentin Cookfamilypi asks about each detail while changing the dressing.
Valentin Cookfamilypi offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Valentin Cookfamilypi reached up to fix a sandbag at U-F3 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Felix Mply of the Hegemony (@shri_mply).

A bullet struck Valentin Cookfamilypi below the ribs at U-F3. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Felix "Mud" Goat of the Hegemony (@eli_is_a_goat). A single shot at U-F3. Valentin Cookfamilypi sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Felix "Mud" Goat of the Hegemony (@eli_is_a_goat).
The House of Cookfamilypi sent another. Pavel Cookfamilypi, older brother of Valentin Cookfamilypi, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
d.colorado_dingle: Day 9. The corporal put Henrik "Brick" Dingle beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Henrik "Brick" Dingle helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Henrik "Brick" Dingle measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. Grey Mill has been won. Henrik "Brick" Dingle listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Henrik "Brick" Dingle and Dorian "Rabbit" Akind sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Henrik "Brick" Dingle left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
The recruit sat beside Henrik "Brick" Dingle at supper but left before the talk began. Henrik "Brick" Dingle passed the bread without trying to start a conversation.
Henrik "Brick" Dingle spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.

Henrik "Brick" Dingle saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R6 and fired once. Henrik "Saint" Leh was gravely wounded. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Henrik "Brick" Dingle waited for that to change. When it did, Wendel Willskeltony was gravely wounded.
The recruit corrected Henrik "Brick" Dingle's account of a football match. It was the longest sentence anyone had heard from that end of the bench.
dominickg516: Casimir "Spark" Dominickg left a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts. The men noticed at once that he reads the same book over and over.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F20 and grazed Casimir "Spark" Dominickg's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel Yaboyslydude of the Concord (@yaboyslydude).

Casimir "Spark" Dominickg was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The medics cleaned Casimir "Spark" Dominickg's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F20. A letter from home reached Casimir "Spark" Dominickg before dusk. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir "Spark" Dominickg turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle. A letter from home reached Casimir "Spark" Dominickg before dusk. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg read it twice and slept a little easier.

A newspaper reached Casimir "Spark" Dominickg with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home reached Casimir "Spark" Dominickg before dusk. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg read it twice and slept a little easier.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.

The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home reached Casimir "Spark" Dominickg before dusk. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg read it twice and slept a little easier.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Casimir "Spark" Dominickg. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 255. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Casimir "Spark" Dominickg. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
The shelling stopped while Casimir "Spark" Dominickg was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.

Casimir "Spark" Dominickg (Hegemony) and Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Sorrow Copse. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Casimir "Spark" Dominickg across the shin at R-F20. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Arno Wolfmecher of the Concord (@wolfmecher8181).

Casimir "Spark" Dominickg was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F20. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Silas Wumpus of the Concord (@flumpus.wumpus). A single shot at R-F20. Casimir "Spark" Dominickg sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Silas Wumpus of the Concord (@flumpus.wumpus).
The papers connected Severin Dominickg to Casimir "Spark" Dominickg. The men took longer to learn Severin Dominickg's own habits, but they made the effort.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Severin Dominickg has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Severin Dominickg, and the soup went cold while Severin Dominickg read it.
donaldgregory334: On the way to S-F18, Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso pulled Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor out of a flooded shell hole at the Drowned Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor cut Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home reached Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor before dusk. Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. A letter from home reached Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor before dusk. Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor was hit through the chest at S-F18. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Leopold "Brick" Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin). Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor was killed outright at S-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Leopold "Brick" Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin).

A letter came with Albin Donaldgregor: "I am Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Albin Donaldgregor became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Albin Donaldgregor raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj). A letter from home reached Albin Donaldgregor before dusk. Albin Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Albin Donaldgregor is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Albin Donaldgregor before dusk. Albin Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Albin Donaldgregor changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. A letter from home reached Albin Donaldgregor before dusk. Albin Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F18 they left Albin Donaldgregor behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Gideon Mirwik of the Concord (@_mirwik_).

The papers say Teodor Donaldgregor. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Albin Donaldgregor's eyes. Nobody in S-F18 argues. Teodor Donaldgregor transferred to the machine gunners. The men in S-F18 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. Teodor Donaldgregor asked for the old family post and took up the work of a sniper. The sergeant remembered the name and signed it without a question.

Teodor Donaldgregor tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. A letter from home reached Teodor Donaldgregor before dusk. Teodor Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Teodor Donaldgregor answered to number 238. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Teodor Donaldgregor helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Lucien Odin, gravely wounded. Teodor Donaldgregor cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Teodor Donaldgregor was hit in the forearm at S-F18. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Valentin "Bones" Lonerius of the Concord (@captain_lonerius).

A bullet found Teodor Donaldgregor at S-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Valentin "Bones" Lonerius of the Concord (@captain_lonerius). Teodor Donaldgregor stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F18. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Valentin "Bones" Lonerius of the Concord (@captain_lonerius).
Another member of the House of Donaldgregor reached the line: Rafael "Tin" Donaldgregor. He asked where Teodor Donaldgregor had slept, then chose a different corner.

A round came through the loophole Rafael "Tin" Donaldgregor was watching at S-F18 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Bram "Owl" Wan of the Concord (@mridz_wan). Rafael "Tin" Donaldgregor was hit at S-F18 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram "Owl" Wan of the Concord (@mridz_wan).
Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor asked about Rafael "Tin" Donaldgregor on arriving at S-F18. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A round went through Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Karel Leothebeo of the Concord (@leothebeo8). A letter from home reached Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor before dusk. Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F18. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Emil "Mole" Odin of the Concord (@odin21320). Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor was killed on watch at S-F18. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Emil "Mole" Odin of the Concord (@odin21320).
Cyril Donaldgregor had heard about Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor's courage. At S-F18, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F18 and grazed Cyril Donaldgregor's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel Thewilliampo of the Concord (@thewilliampoole). Cyril Donaldgregor got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
elm227987: Henrik "Hollow" Elm joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Henrik "Hollow" Elm wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Jakub Faulerhund (Hegemony) and Henrik "Hollow" Elm (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Lantern Hill for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik "Hollow" Elm. Henrik "Hollow" Elm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Henrik "Hollow" Elm watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F19 and grazed Henrik "Hollow" Elm's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Casimir Lordfulgrim of the Hegemony (@lordfulgrim). Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik "Hollow" Elm. Henrik "Hollow" Elm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The medic cut the last bandage off Henrik "Hollow" Elm's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to T-F19 the same hour.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Henrik "Hollow" Elm. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Henrik "Hollow" Elm. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Henrik "Hollow" Elm fought Cyril Schaefer in a trench no wider than a door. Henrik "Hollow" Elm came home with Cyril Schaefer's cap badge. (@riley_schaefer.2) Henrik "Hollow" Elm counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Henrik "Saint" Marshman never saw the shovel coming. (@asa_marshman)
Henrik "Hollow" Elm dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
ethan_snelling6: Nobody saw Nils Snelling arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-C13, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Nils Snelling during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Nils Snelling cut Severin Vazintian's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Nils Snelling got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 899. The men who came later will ask about it. Nils Snelling walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
A bullet went through Nils Snelling's sleeve at R-C13 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Silas Tadzyman of the Concord (@tadzyman).
Three days with a bandage, and Nils Snelling is back at R-C13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Nils Snelling opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Nils Snelling is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
Nils Snelling ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Nils Snelling across the shin at R-C13. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Isidor Broxxhemi of the Concord (@broxxhemi).
gallianrecon: Isidor Gallianrecon walked into P-F15 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Isidor Gallianrecon's ear at P-F15 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony (@great_ruthenianfascist). From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor Gallianrecon wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A bullet found Isidor Gallianrecon at P-F15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Bram Deposito of the Hegemony (@deposito_78).
Isidor Gallianrecon lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
For days Isidor Gallianrecon was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

At P-F15 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Isidor Gallianrecon won the bet. Wendel "Crow" Xanny was badly wounded. Isidor Gallianrecon fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Bram Deposito was grazed. Isidor Gallianrecon ate breakfast without a word.
Isidor Gallianrecon borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

Isidor Gallianrecon fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Florian Dcf, now badly wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Isidor Gallianrecon aimed a step ahead and fired: Roland Jester, badly wounded.
geddy__97: On Day 6 Dietrich "Spark" Geddy took a post at S-S11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hates silence more than shelling, and the men liked him for it. Orders assigned Dietrich "Spark" Geddy to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Dietrich "Spark" Geddy. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

Dietrich "Spark" Geddy got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

From the heights Dietrich "Spark" Geddy could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Dietrich "Spark" Geddy had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Isidor Eccentricred was grazed. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

No post for Dietrich "Spark" Geddy this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

Two men fed the belt while Dietrich "Spark" Geddy held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Marek Olie was grazed. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

A parcel from Josef: socks, a cake gone hard as a brick, and a pressed flower. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy ate the cake and kept the flower in a child's drawing of a horse's place. A letter from home found Dietrich "Spark" Geddy before the night shift. Dietrich "Spark" Geddy folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Hansen lent Dietrich "Spark" Geddy a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. The letter for Dietrich "Spark" Geddy had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Dietrich "Spark" Geddy kept them.

Dietrich "Spark" Geddy cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry. A thin letter reached Dietrich "Spark" Geddy. Only five lines long, and Dietrich "Spark" Geddy knew every one of them by heart before supper.
kade_kernal: On Day 12 Nils "Shadow" Kernal took a post at N-F10 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it.

Nils "Shadow" Kernal tried to remember the price of a loaf in Halden. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. A letter from home found Nils "Shadow" Kernal before the night shift. Nils "Shadow" Kernal folded it small and kept it close.

Nils "Shadow" Kernal saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home found Nils "Shadow" Kernal before the night shift. Nils "Shadow" Kernal folded it small and kept it close.

Nils "Shadow" Kernal pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Grey Mill and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him. A letter from home found Nils "Shadow" Kernal before the night shift. Nils "Shadow" Kernal folded it small and kept it close.
Nils "Shadow" Kernal measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A note came over the wire at Sorrow Copse, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Nils "Shadow" Kernal.' Jonas Little sang louder.
kevin_hld_: Day 13: Dorian Hld reached N-F14 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The stretcher bearers took Dorian Hld in on a busy morning in N-F14. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Dorian Hld got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. A letter from home found Dorian Hld before the night shift. Dorian Hld folded it small and kept it close.
Bram Foxeye owes Dorian Hld so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Dorian Hld wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of N-F14. When Dorian Hld challenged it, there was nobody there.
mi33szko: Nobody asked Bastian Szko why he came. Nobody in S-S11 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle. Bastian Szko transferred to the stretcher bearers. The men in S-S11 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Jonas Miked and Bastian Szko tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home reached Bastian Szko before dusk. Bastian Szko read it twice and slept a little easier.

The telephone went dead during the shelling. Bastian Szko watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again. A letter from home reached Bastian Szko before dusk. Bastian Szko read it twice and slept a little easier.
New laces made Bastian Szko's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

Bastian Szko came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Bastian Szko kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet found Bastian Szko at S-S11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony (@parker.j.mccauley). Bastian Szko was killed on watch at S-S11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony (@parker.j.mccauley).

Emil Szko asked about Bastian Szko on arriving at S-S11. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Emil Szko got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 443. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S11. Emil Szko has learned to walk bent double.
Emil Szko cut Hugo "Bones" Squared's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Emil Szko raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Ivo Maupat of the Hegemony (@maupat_03).
Back on the fire step at S-S11. Emil Szko says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Emil Szko (Concord) and Felix Dougc (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Saint-Ash crossroads at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Emil Szko remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Emil Szko tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Kesselby. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
mikkel.hansen27: Nils Hansen reached S-F4 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Nils Hansen. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Nils Hansen left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

A shell landed square in S-F4. They found Nils Hansen alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. The shell that hit S-F4 took Nils Hansen with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.
Silas Hansen took the same post at S-F4 where Nils Hansen stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Silas Hansen borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Silas Hansen wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. Silas Hansen reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Silas Hansen hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Hansen saw Viktor Thervvival freeze up on the fire step at the Hanging Bridge. Silas said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Hansen counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Jakub "Shadow" Camper was grazed. A bullet clipped Silas Hansen's helmet at S-F4 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Roland Maccerny of the Concord (@maccerny808). A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Hansen's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F4 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

The raid was quick, the way back was not. Silas Hansen snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Silas Hansen free. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Silas Hansen could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Silas Hansen waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas Hansen is number 228. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Silas Hansen during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Silas Hansen spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-F4.

A round went through Silas Hansen's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Clement Lynallwarrio of the Concord (@lynallwarrior51). A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

The medic cut the last bandage off Silas Hansen's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F4 the same hour. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Hansen sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour. A letter from home found Silas Hansen before the night shift. Silas Hansen folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Hansen lent Dietrich "Spark" Geddy a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. A letter for Silas Hansen came with a photograph. Silas Hansen looked at it for a long time and said nothing.

An empty jam tin became Silas Hansen's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. The letter for Silas Hansen ended with 'come home soon'. Silas Hansen read the last line more than the rest. After what happened at Saint-Ash crossroads, Silas asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.
raivantm.zgz: Albin Zgz signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F14 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Albin Zgz was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Albin Zgz and Edmund Fts divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion.
Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Albin Zgz could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Albin Zgz (Concord) and Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Chalk Pits. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.

Albin Zgz and Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A letter from home found Albin Zgz before the night shift. Albin Zgz folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Fts pulled Albin Zgz out of a flooded shell hole at Calvary Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Hill 304 is lost. Albin Zgz heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Albin Zgz raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Casimir Toro of the Hegemony (@fidel_del_toro).
Albin Zgz no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A bullet grazed Albin Zgz's ribs at S-F14. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Otto Carlingiti of the Hegemony (@carlingiti).
Albin Zgz came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

At S-F14 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Albin Zgz turned around and took a shovel blow. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Florian "Spark" Cwilliam of the Hegemony (@cwilliam357). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Albin Zgz helped stack spare sandbags at S-F14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F14. Albin Zgz took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Benedikt "Button" Niarchos of the Hegemony (@niarchos_n). Albin Zgz was killed on watch at S-F14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Benedikt "Button" Niarchos of the Hegemony (@niarchos_n).

The papers connected Emil Zgz to Albin Zgz. The men took longer to learn Emil Zgz's own habits, but they made the effort. First Wave. Emil Zgz signed when the ink on the posters was still fresh. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a cracked shaving mirror. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Emil Zgz watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Emil Zgz got a letter from Marguerite. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Emil Zgz felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999).

Emil Zgz was found at the bottom of the trench at S-F14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla). Emil Zgz stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F14. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla).
Yann Zgz took the same post at S-F14 where Emil Zgz stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Yann Zgz did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Yann Zgz fired back. Jakub Lft was badly wounded.
Yann Zgz counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping.
On sentry duty Yann Zgz watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
ratpick45: Gustav "Tin" Ratpick arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home found Gustav "Tin" Ratpick before the night shift. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick folded it small and kept it close.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. A letter from home found Gustav "Tin" Ratpick before the night shift. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick folded it small and kept it close. The transfer made Gustav "Tin" Ratpick a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick fired, and Leopold "Owl" Viti was grazed. A letter from home found Gustav "Tin" Ratpick before the night shift. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick folded it small and kept it close.

Gustav "Tin" Ratpick saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home found Gustav "Tin" Ratpick before the night shift. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick folded it small and kept it close.

Gustav "Tin" Ratpick cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Sorrow Copse. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic. A letter from home found Gustav "Tin" Ratpick before the night shift. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick folded it small and kept it close.

Gustav "Tin" Ratpick's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning. A letter from home found Gustav "Tin" Ratpick before the night shift. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick folded it small and kept it close.

There was never a bed for Gustav "Tin" Ratpick, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to Q-F10 on his own feet. A letter for Gustav "Tin" Ratpick said the whole street was asking about the front. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick did not know where to begin the answer.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick ate two helpings anyway. The letter for Gustav "Tin" Ratpick was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Gustav "Tin" Ratpick liked the crossed-out parts best.
thehassand: Nobody asked Albin "Ash" Thehassand why he came. Nobody in V-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Albin "Ash" Thehassand held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
Cyril Roland (Hegemony) threw a loaf of bread into the Concord trench at Lantern Hill. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Albin "Ash" Thehassand: 'Fair trade.'
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Albin "Ash" Thehassand aimed a step ahead and fired: Ivo Omombintaro, grazed.
Albin "Ash" Thehassand let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Felix Chanley was badly wounded.
Listening post, three in the morning. Albin "Ash" Thehassand heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards.
Albin "Ash" Thehassand fired at the enemy dawn watch from V-F16. Benedikt "Tin" Codibandz was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
trevor.f78: Cyril "Crow" Trevor signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-S8 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Cyril "Crow" Trevor put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Cyril "Crow" Trevor helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Cyril "Crow" Trevor helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.
Quentin Zanetaylor and Cyril "Crow" Trevor divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Cyril "Crow" Trevor cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Cyril "Crow" Trevor and Quentin Zanetaylor cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

Cyril "Crow" Trevor fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Ulrich Alessiosanto was badly wounded. Cyril "Crow" Trevor ate breakfast without a word. The men at R-S8 heard Cyril "Crow" Trevor call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Valentin "Button" Boi of the Concord (@gremlin_boi32). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Cyril "Crow" Trevor fell at R-S8 and never moved again. Shot by Valentin "Button" Boi of the Concord (@gremlin_boi32).
The House of Trevor sent Albin Trevor after Cyril "Crow" Trevor. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Albin Trevor found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Albin Trevor is number 364. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Albin Trevor could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A bullet went through Albin Trevor's sleeve at R-S8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Cyril "Spark" Jesus of the Concord (@topgun_jesus).
Albin Trevor no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Albin Trevor's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Albin Trevor spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
A bullet hit Albin Trevor's belt buckle at R-S8 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli of the Concord (@mj_rahimli).
The medic looked at Albin Trevor's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S8. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
ware_is_they_at_tho: The draft reached U-F4 on Day 10. Nils "Brick" Tho was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Nils "Brick" Tho spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils "Brick" Tho. Nils "Brick" Tho read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. After the loss of Grey Mill, Nils "Brick" Tho helped stack spare sandbags at U-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Nils "Brick" Tho carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils "Brick" Tho. Nils "Brick" Tho read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Nils "Brick" Tho watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils "Brick" Tho. Nils "Brick" Tho read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Nils "Brick" Tho tried to remember the price of a loaf in Kesselby. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils "Brick" Tho. Nils "Brick" Tho read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Nils "Brick" Tho shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.

Nils "Brick" Tho came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Back from the raid, Nils "Brick" Tho found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Dreamer' (rare). Nobody asked where it came from. A letter reached Nils "Brick" Tho in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

The medic looked at Nils "Brick" Tho's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to U-F4. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Nils "Brick" Tho kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
yelloowman: The sergeant gave Quentin Yelloowman a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Quentin Yelloowman helped stack spare sandbags at P-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Quentin Yelloowman before dusk. Quentin Yelloowman read it twice and slept a little easier.

Quentin Yelloowman (Concord) watched Otto Elitecelebs (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Saint-Ash crossroads, and held fire until both were gone. A letter from home reached Quentin Yelloowman before dusk. Quentin Yelloowman read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Quentin Yelloowman watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A bullet hit Quentin Yelloowman in the neck at P-F13. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Jakub Soukup of the Hegemony (@vazeny_pan_soukup). Quentin Yelloowman was hit at P-F13 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Jakub Soukup of the Hegemony (@vazeny_pan_soukup).

Marek Yelloowman asked about Quentin Yelloowman on arriving at P-F13. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Marek Yelloowman left the work of a stretcher bearer to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Marek Yelloowman was found at the bottom of the trench at P-F13, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Bram Deposito of the Hegemony (@deposito_78). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Marek Yelloowman fell at P-F13 and never moved again. Shot by Bram Deposito of the Hegemony (@deposito_78).
Casimir Yelloowman arrived carrying the family name of Marek Yelloowman. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Casimir Yelloowman wrote a letter for Dietrich Jakegriffal's mother, because Dietrich could not find the words. Dietrich signed it. A letter from home reached Casimir Yelloowman before dusk. Casimir Yelloowman read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Yelloowman and Leopold "Crow" Napoleon share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. A letter from home reached Casimir Yelloowman before dusk. Casimir Yelloowman read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Yelloowman threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Clement "Spark" Jcksn was down and screaming for a medic. (@l.jcksn) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Casimir Yelloowman landed next to Norbert Kuty in the Hegemony trench. Only Casimir Yelloowman climbed back out. (@michael.kuty) The letter for Casimir Yelloowman was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Casimir Yelloowman liked the crossed-out parts best.

Casimir Yelloowman wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. The runner said a letter for Casimir Yelloowman had come up with the ammunition. Casimir Yelloowman went to get it before the ammunition.
